items.title: What Does Uber Technologies (UBER) Winning Spain's First Robotaxi Permit Mean?
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER), WeRide and AVOMO secured Spain's first national Level 4 autonomous passenger permit for Madrid services. The authorization covers commercial robotaxi operations, clearing a regulatory path for paid autonomous rides in the Spanish capital. Spain's national approval introduces a European testbed for Uber's autonomous offering alongside Chinese partner WeRide and local operator AVOMO.
